lines.text: Please! Stop smoking already! I promise I'll stop pressing you again.
And no more of that strange beeps.
Endmin! Oh, please take a look and see if it's alright.
I tried my best to follow the manual ... but it started giving off smoke after moving around a bit.
And it just refuses to stop making the strange beeping noises. It's been beeping non-stop all day.

options: Let me see what happened to it.

r: Let me see what happened to it.

lines.text: Did you fix it?
Typhoeus? Oh... Hold on. Wow. How did I miss all these Baker toasts?
I'm so sorry. I got too busy with work these few days.
It's alright.
Mister Andre, you left behind a machine. What is it for?
Ah, you used up your treasured arrows to save me! The machine is a token of my gratitude!
Simply feed the machine with things you gathered from the forest. It'll make you all sorts of arrows.
The new arrows are just part of the entire package. When I first arrived at the warehouse, I think it would be perfect for an ⟦key|archery range⟧.
When you're taking breaks from studying the manuscripts and notes, visit the range for some archery practice.
Thank you, Mister Andre.
But ... I'm worried I might break the machine again.
See, even the Endmin's willing to chip in. Be brave and try things out.
You might even find it really fun.

options: Don't worry. I got the time to help.

r: Don't worry. I got the time to help.

lines.text: Oh. The trial has been completed. What do you think? Got any user-experience feedback for me?
It's really good...
You're so incredible, Mister Andre.
Heheh. And I'm glad to hear that. The way you cast Originium Arts has been the inspiration for my designs.
Thank you. I'll use these ⟦key|chips⟧ for my daily exercises with the bow.
It's my first trial, so I'm not very familiar with it.
Great. If you encounter any issues, contact us. Any time!
I will.
Endmin, thanks for training with me.
The Samifjod often set up interesting targets for our archery ranges.
And it just happens that Mister Andre has made a ⟦key|new chip⟧.
How's that, Endmin? Interested in more challenges?

options: It's alright. It's just like working out.

r: It's alright. It's just like working out.

lines.text: Thank you for your assistance. This archery range is now offering a full set of amenities.
The upgraded archery range also features tougher challenges... Oh my. I think the difficulty spike is a little too much.
I know training can get pretty boring, so I designed a training program that changes every day.
But you and Typhoeus should be able to beat them easily.
